svg.title: Toolmaker — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as toolmaker, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A C-frame micrometer has an upper anvil, lower spindle and thimble, with a narrow part in the measuring gap. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face.
